hero.title: Social dialogue for lasting social peace in the workplace.
hero.slogan: “Social dialogue for lasting social peace in the workplace”
hero.description: The CNDS brings together the Government, employers, and workers around a shared objective: building sustainable social peace in the world of work in Burundi.

tripartite.title: Three constituents, one dialogue table
tripartite.subtitle: The committee consists of 22 members: 21 representatives of social partners (7 per group) and an independent chairperson.
tripartite.govDesc: Represents the State in tripartite discussions and oversees the implementation of social dialogue policies.
tripartite.empDesc: Voices the interests of the private sector and employers' organizations in social negotiations.
tripartite.traDesc: Defends the rights and interests of Burundian workers within national consultation bodies.
tripartite.independent: Ensures neutrality, mediation, and cohesion of deliberations among the three groups.

about.title: An Institution Born of Dialogue
about.p1: The CNDS is a National Committee for Social Dialogue established to sustain social peace in the workplace in Burundi. The tripartite constituents — Government, Employers, Workers — signed the National Charter for Social Dialogue on May 25, 2011, in Gitega.
about.p2: This charter describes the mechanisms of social dialogue in Burundi and advocated for the creation of a National Committee for Social Dialogue, established by decree and composed of equal representatives from the three groups.
about.visionText: “A Burundi where sustainable social peace reigns through proactive tripartite partnership for enhanced productivity and decent work”.

timeline.title: Major Founding Dates
timeline.date1Desc: Signing of the National Charter for Social Dialogue in Gitega by the tripartite constituents.
timeline.date2Desc: Decree No. 100/47 establishing the creation, composition, and operation of the CNDS.
timeline.date3Desc: Decree No. 100/132 revising the founding decree.
timeline.date4Desc: Decree No. 238 appointing the President, and Decree No. 239 appointing the members of the CNDS.
